accessories.name: External Motorized Calibration unit
accessories.title: ECM-XS: External calibration unit for Optino
accessories.description: External motorized calibration unit designed for high precision calibration of Optino and wavefront measurement systems.

images.caption: ECM-XS: External calibration unit for Optino

details: Automated calibration workflow integrated with Sensoft software.
Ensures sub-nanometer wavefront reference accuracy across single and double pass setups.

accessories.name: Beam Expanders/Beam Compressors
accessories.title: Beam Expander and Beam Compressor for OMI/Optino
accessories.description: SpotOptics can provide Beam Expanders that can expand/(compress) the optical beam to test optical elements up to 120mm diameter.

images.caption: Beam Expander BE120 mounted on the Dual Channel wavefront sensor Optino600.
Beam Expander: BE60 motorized Beam Expander/compressor with OMI
Beam Expander: BE-XS (center) with the External Calibration unit ECM-XS (left) and Optino-XS (right)

details: The same unit can be also used in Beam Compressor configuration.
Each Beam Expander/Compressor cover different magnifications, that can be changed manually or automatically by software (in the motorized version).
Beam Expander contains optical elements whose effect/aberrations should be subtracted with the calibration. We provide the setup for calibration with our Beam Expanders.
